messages:
Omar H: Drafting internal release note for tomorrow's micro-deploy. Need a one-line pin + rollout plan. Can someone shorten and add rollback command?
Nina V: Drop draft here and Ill make it channel-friendly. Keep it <140 chars.
Omar H: Draft: ```
Micro-deploy: tune request scheduler to smooth spikes and lower p99 by ~12%. Canary 5%->30%->100% over 25m. Rollback to tag v2026-03-20-sched if issues. See PR: https://github.com/redwood/infer/pull/1310
```
Nina V: One-liner for pin: "Scheduler tuning (no model/config changes). Canary 5%30%100% over 25m. Rollback: v2026-03-20-sched. PR: github.com/redwood/infer/pull/1310"
Becky L: Can you paste exact rollback command? Oncall should be able to run it without searching.
Ravi S: Rollback command snippet: ```sh
redwood deploy --env=prod --tag=v2026-03-20-sched --force --reason="sched-tune-regression"
# verify: redwood status --env=prod | grep v2026-03-20-sched
```
Nina V: I'll pin that copy and add standby roster: Omar (APAC), Nina (US-PST), Becky (US-EST). Also adding smoke checks: errors >0.75% for 3m -> rollback.
Becky L: Observability query for escalation: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference",status=~"5.."}[2m]))` and compare to baseline of 25rps. Escalate if > baseline * 2.
Omar H: Good. @DeployBot can you schedule canary at 2026-03-20T16:00:00Z and pin RN at T-20? Also tag the standby roster.
DeployBot: Canary scheduled for 2026-03-20 16:00 UTC. Steps [5%,30%,100%] with 7m checks. RN pin request submitted to #eng-releases for 15:40 UTC.
Ravi S: Also draft a tiny customer blurb: "We deployed a small scheduler improvement to reduce latency; no action required." Becky can you sanity-check legal?
Becky L: LGTM. Keeping customer-facing short.
Nina V: Pin is live. I've included PR link, rollback command, standby roster, and escalation thresholds in the pinned message.
Omar H: Thanks all. Plan: pin at T-20, start canary at 16:00 UTC, quick smoke at 5m, metrics checks at 7m and 20m, full rollout at 100% if healthy. Posting a start message when canary kicks off. :rocket:
DeployBot: RN pinned by Nina V. Canary job waiting for manual start at 16:00 UTC.
